cs.t: I got some Comply tips and they're great. Was weary of the idea of foam tips at first. I am pretty used to the feeling of earplugs though and it hasn't been an issue. Frankly they're TOO good sometimes, I've been startled by people trying to get my attention more than once.

I'd recommend the Monoprice Enhanced Bass Hi-Fi Noise Isolating Earphones with the Comply TX-400 foam tips. You'd be amazed at the sound these earbuds can put out.  https://www.monoprice.com/Product?c_id=108&cp_id=10823&cs_id...   http://www.complyfoam.com/products/Tx-400/  Good luck with the search!
